newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Talks on sale of Jinhui stake terminated.
newsitem.headline: Talks on sale of Jinhui stake terminated.

text.p: Jinhui Holdings Co Ltd said on Wednesday its controlling shareholder, Fairline Consultants Ltd, notified the company that negotiations with an independent third party on sales of its interest in Jinhui have been terminated.
Fairline, which is controlled by Jinhui chairman Ng Siu Fai and executive director Thomas Ng, holds about 61.95 percent of Jinhui's issued share capital.
Jinhui said earlier Fairline was in preliminary talks with an independent third party who had expressed interest in buying the whole or part of Fairline's shareholding in the company.
Fairline confirmed it was not engaged in any current talks relating to sale of its shareholding in the company, the shipping services company said.
Jinhui shares eased five cents to HK$1.76 at mid-morning Wednesday.
